messages:
maya: quick FYI onboarding aurora-44b weights to s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora-44b-v1 — pushed pjones/weights.tar.gz
maya: tokenizer files look like sentencepiece.model + spm.vocab but vocab_size in config is 32000 and .vocab has 30005. hitting tokenization mismatch on local decode
leo: can you paste the gsutil path for weights + the model card? I want to run a quick serve smoke
maya: s3 path above. model card at https://docs.redwood/models/aurora-44b/v1
samir: heads-up: this family uses GQA-64 in training. runtime config defaulted to MQA false but GQA flag wasn't set. that can make rotary scale math blow up — especially with flash_attn
ashley: is rotary_scaling enabled? last time we saw numeric instabilities when rope.scale == 1.0 and GQA/MQA mismatch
maya: current model config snippet i diffed:
```
attention_config: { type: "flash_attn", rotary_scaling: 1.0, qk_groups: 1 }
model_parallel: { gqa: false, mqa: false }
sliding_window: { enabled: false }
```

maya: so yeah mismatch
samir: suggest change to:
```
attention_config: { type: "flash_attn", rotary_scaling: 1.0001, qk_groups: 64 }
model_parallel: { gqa: true, mqa: false }
sliding_window: { enabled: true, chunk_size: 2048 }
```

samir: small rotary_scaling tweak to avoid exact-power crossover; qk_groups=64 mirrors training; enable sliding window so KV cache works for long contexts
leo: @infra-bot can you preflight a canary with this config on one 8xA100 node? want to validate perf & numerics
infra-bot: scheduled canary run 2136789120 on ded-gpu-pool-8a100 with image: inference:v2.4 — will post logs here
oncall: pinging runtime oncall — if we see segfault or OOM, fallback plan is: switch to attention_impl: 'safe_attention' and gqa=false, which will reduce perf but should be stable
ashley: also watch tokenizer mapping: I'll add tokenizer_override to map missing tokens to <unk> to avoid crashes while we reconcile vocab
maya: thanks — i'll push a PR with config change + tokenizer_override. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/842
leo: quick code-review nits done, left 1 comment about unit test for tokenization mismatch
maya: added tests, CI green. infra-bot: canary logs? 
infra-bot: canary finished 2136789350 — no segfaults; latency 5% higher with sliding_window, numerics stable, top-1 sample outputs look sane. logs: https://ci.redwood/inference/canary/2136789120
samir: LGTM — we'll roll to canary pool tomorrow 10:00 PDT, then to wider pool after 24h if no regressions :thumbsup:
maya: thanks team. closing thread, will follow up in release notes.
